verdicts.matching_evidence: In Section 2.4, Equation 3, the block-ALS update for $V$ is given as $V \leftarrow T_\tau \left( \left[ (U^\top U - \epsilon I)^{-1} U^\top R \right]^\top \right)$. Subtracting $\epsilon I$ from the Gram matrix $U^\top U$ is mathematically incorrect for Tikhonov regularization (decorrelation); it destabilizes the matrix inverse by driving small eigenvalues closer to zero, risking singularities. The corresponding update for $U$ correctly uses addition: $(V^\top V + \epsilon I)^{-1}$. This must be fixed by changing $(U^\top U - \epsilon I)^{-1}$ to $(U^\top U + \epsilon I)^{-1}$.
